区内の回収施設へ。近くにない場合は清掃事務所に相談。可燃ごみに絶対に混ぜない: Take it to a collection facility in the city. If none is nearby, consult the 清掃事務所 (waste collection office). Never mix with 可燃ごみ (burnable waste).

リネットジャパン（本体を含めば1箱無料）またはメーカー回収（PC3R）: Renet Japan (one box free if a PC unit is included) or manufacturer collection (PC3R).

充電式電池内蔵製品。乾電池式は電池を外して出す: A product with a built-in rechargeable battery. For dry-cell types, remove the batteries before putting it out.
電源コードはできるだけ切る: Cut off the power cord as much as possible.

一辺30cm以下は不燃ごみ、30cmを超えるものは粗大ごみ。サイズを測って判断: Items with a side of 30 cm or less are 不燃ごみ (non-burnable waste); items over 30 cm are 粗大ごみ (oversized waste). Measure the size to decide.
一辺30cm以下なら不燃ごみ: 不燃ごみ (non-burnable waste) if each side is 30 cm or less.

切っても粗大ごみ扱い: Even if cut up, it is treated as 粗大ごみ (oversized waste).

区が把握する処理業者（区のページに掲載）などに引き取りを依頼。集積所や公園に出す: Ask a disposal company known to the city (listed on the city's page) or similar to take it. Putting it out at a 集積所 (collection point) or in a park is illegal dumping.
着られるものは地域の古着回収やエコプラザ用賀・リサイクル千歳台の常設回収へ: Wearable items can go to local used-clothing collection or the permanent collection at Eco Plaza Yoga or Recycle Chitosedai.
